description: This file defines the 'GrainReferenceRuntime' class, which implements the 'IGrainReferenceRuntime' interface. It handles invoking methods on grain references asynchronously, applying filters, managing cancellation tokens, and creating grain references based on interface types within the Orleans distributed actor framework.

classes.name: GrainReferenceRuntime
classes.description: Implements method invocation logic for grain references in Orleans, supporting filters, cancellation tokens, and reference creation.

methods.name: InvokeMethodAsync<TResult>
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes a method on a grain reference with a specified request and options, returning a result of type TResult.

methods.name: InvokeMethodAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes a method on a grain reference with a specified request and options, returning a task.

methods.name: InvokeMethod
methods.description: Performs a one-way method invocation on a grain reference.

methods.name: Cast
methods.description: Converts a generic addressable grain to a specific grain reference based on interface type.
